name: Color Chaos
description: Collaborative numbered coloring game for TikTok LIVE - viewers comment a region number plus a color; gifts fire color power-ups.

effects.premium_color: apply a premium color (gold/neon/rainbow) to a region
effects.multi_fill: fill several uncolored regions at once
effects.clear_region: clear one region back to white
effects.rename_region: label a region with the gifter's name
effects.rainbow_sweep: fill a series of regions with random colors
effects.priority_join: gift jumps the viewer to the front of the turn queue
effects.fill_1: pixel mode: fill a cell of color 1 (black)
effects.fill_2: pixel mode: fill a cell of color 2 (white)
effects.fill_3: pixel mode: fill a cell of color 3 (red)
effects.fill_4: pixel mode: fill a cell of color 4 (orange)
effects.fill_5: pixel mode: fill a cell of color 5 (yellow)
effects.fill_6: pixel mode: fill a cell of color 6 (green)
effects.fill_7: pixel mode: fill a cell of color 7 (cyan)
effects.fill_8: pixel mode: fill a cell of color 8 (blue)
effects.fill_9: pixel mode: fill a cell of color 9 (magenta)
effects.fill_brush: pixel mode power-up: fill several cells
effects.reveal_color: pixel mode power-up: finish a whole color
effects.reveal_all: pixel mode power-up: complete the mural
effects.golden_pixel: pixel mode power-up: a golden cell
